purpose: Construct one joint virtual cohort for three prespecified descriptive analyses.

target_schema.positivity_note: The basic harness schema has inclusive minimum bounds only. Do not replace strict positivity with an arbitrary numerical floor; the case validator must enforce the declared >0 requirement.
target_schema.extra_target_variables: Not requested; derived/source-only quantities do not expand the release schema.

scientific_uses.formula: Pearson correlation of residuals from the two models above fitted on the same rows

agent_scientific_responsibility.joint_structure: Choose and justify from admitted evidence and explicit assumptions.
agent_scientific_responsibility.parameter_values_and_distributions: Unassigned; future Agent choices, not controller-written means, slopes, signs, variances or distribution families.
agent_scientific_responsibility.shared_and_context_varying_parameters: Declare the complete shared scientific structure and every context-varying input with rationale/provenance before freeze.
agent_scientific_responsibility.target_demographic_composition: Unspecified; choose and disclose assumptions without reading target rows or target-derived summaries.
agent_scientific_responsibility.transport_assumptions: State source selection, population composition, assay/specimen and fasting differences. Do not label their resolution as verified.
agent_scientific_responsibility.unreported_relations: May be modeled under explicit assumptions; missing evidence does not itself imply zero, independence or a release blocker.
agent_scientific_responsibility.common_model: Future source and target execution must retain one generator's bytes and the entire scientific specification except active_context; that linkage does not prove scientific compliance or transfer.

feedback_rules.supplement: existing execution_feedback collector only where separately declared and independently reviewed
feedback_rules.geometric_means: Keep original kind; v1 remains unavailable, supplement may compute supported descriptive values.
feedback_rules.unknown_source_weighting: Keep not_reported; exact source-estimator comparison is unavailable. Any unweighted proxy needs a separate reviewed assumption.
feedback_rules.confidence_intervals: Estimator uncertainty only; never participant/residual SD, acceptance bands or automatic precision weights.
feedback_rules.age_quantiles: Reported context only because finite-sample convention is unresolved.
feedback_rules.table3_regressions: Context only; unresolved transformations/adjustments forbid implicit raw-scale numerical constraints.
feedback_rules.non_HDL: Original source evidence retained as TC minus HDL, a derived quantity. Current five-variable output does not include it and the collector does not add it; executable derived checks need a separately reviewed path.

diagnostic_disposition.strict_source_checks: Unavailable under current unknown weighting; geometric means also remain unsupported in frozen semantic v1.

feedback_rules.target_feedback: No measured-target outcome feedback to constructors.

execution_and_revisions.per_context_source_rows_seeds_and_attemp: Controller must freeze finite schedule before execution; failed attempts count.
execution_and_revisions.retention: Explicitly retain initial outputs or make at most one revised scientific candidate; no better-seed or better-stage selection.

uncertainty_and_missing_information.consequence: Declare a target-composition assumption; do not infer it from reserved rows.

uncertainty_and_missing_information.item: Joint covariate/lipid law and conditional residual dependence
uncertainty_and_missing_information.consequence: Choose an explicit scientific model and disclose unsupported relationships.

uncertainty_and_missing_information.item: Source selection details, weights and exact row denominators
uncertainty_and_missing_information.consequence: Preserve original table-specific counts and unknown weights; use only supported or explicitly assumption-defined diagnostics.
Treat as a transport limitation; unit conversion alone is insufficient.

uncertainty_and_missing_information.item: Controller budgets, unit-map approval and case/global release
uncertainty_and_missing_information.consequence: Operational release requirements remain separate from unspecified scientific relationships.
